Opened PR #12 on product/bug-86 (ae4a5763dffd2f5743836f2679394c67607cb42f) for BUG-86:
- bin/cargo (seed_target, check_target_disk) and bin/cargo-log (target_disk_info) invoke ${AIDA_CARGO_DF_CMD:-df} -Pk <probe>.
- tests/test_cargo_wrapper.sh exports AIDA_CARGO_TARGET_FS="$T/target-fs" and AIDA_CARGO_DF_CMD="$T/df-bin/df" (200 GiB / 50% default) near the top alongside AIDA_CARGO_PSI_DIR and AIDA_CARGO_MEMINFO.
- Added Section 26 hermeticity test and verified full test_cargo_wrapper.sh passes with your /tmp/.../scratchpad/lowdf stub prepended to PATH.
subject: PR #12 ready for review: aida-host BUG-86 (ae4a5763dffd2f5743836f2679394c67607cb42f)
